answer: Each identity posts a 60-credit onyx bond at reputation 100, losing 5 points per idle epoch. Filed work is one cipher receipt proving a job, bound to its key. Idle identities hit 50 within ten epochs and lose eligibility. Auditors check the beacon checkpoint; a mismatch slashes the bond. The k-th fake costs the same 90 credits (60 bond, 30 work) as the first, so 1,000 fakes cost 90,000 credits plus that bill thereafter, with no discount or reuse. Renting fails, since a rented receipt matches its owner's key and reuse slashes bonds. An honest agent files one receipt and pays 90 credits.
